_comment: Error message strings for VA Form 10-2850e — VHA Clinical Position Application. All messages follow VA.gov plain language guidelines: active voice, action-oriented, specific about what went wrong and what to do next. ⚠️ Verify all messages against final form requirements before production launch.

applicantType.required: Select the type of application you are submitting.

lastName.pattern: Enter a valid last name using only letters, hyphens, apostrophes, and spaces.
lastName.maxLength: Last name must be 50 characters or fewer.

firstName.pattern: Enter a valid first name using only letters, hyphens, apostrophes, and spaces.
firstName.maxLength: First name must be 50 characters or fewer.

middleName.maxLength: Middle name must be 50 characters or fewer.

dateOfBirth.invalidDate: Enter a valid date of birth. Check that the month, day, and year are correct.
dateOfBirth.invalidDay: Enter a valid day for the month you selected.
dateOfBirth.invalidYear: Enter a valid year between 1900 and the current year.
dateOfBirth.futureDate: Date of birth can't be in the future.
dateOfBirth.tooYoung: You must be at least 18 years old to submit this application.

ssn.pattern: Enter a valid 9-digit Social Security number. Example: 123-45-6789.
ssn.format: Enter your Social Security number in the format XXX-XX-XXXX.

cityOfBirth.maxLength: City of birth must be 100 characters or fewer.

stateCountryOfBirth.required: Select your state or country of birth.

homeAddress.streetMaxLength: Street address must be 100 characters or fewer.
homeAddress.zipPattern: Enter a valid ZIP code. Use 5 digits (12345) or 9 digits with a hyphen (12345-6789).

mailingAddress.zipPattern: Enter a valid ZIP code. Use 5 digits (12345) or 9 digits with a hyphen (12345-6789).

primaryPhone.pattern: Enter a valid 10-digit U.S. phone number. Example: 202-555-0100.

alternatePhone.pattern: Enter a valid 10-digit U.S. phone number. Example: 202-555-0100.

professionalEmail.pattern: Enter a valid email address. Example: name@organization.org.

citizenshipStatus.required: Select your citizenship or work authorization status.

visaType.required: Enter your visa or work authorization type.

veteranStatus.required: Tell us whether you are a Veteran.

licensure.licenseTypeRequired: Select the type of professional license.
licensure.issuingStateRequired: Select the state or jurisdiction that issued this license.
licensure.licenseNumberPattern: Enter a valid license number using only letters, numbers, and hyphens.
licensure.licenseNumberMaxLength: License number must be 50 characters or fewer.
licensure.issueDateRequired: Enter the date this license was issued.
licensure.issueDateInvalid: Enter a valid issue date. Check that the month, day, and year are correct.
licensure.issueDateFuture: Issue date can't be in the future.
licensure.expirationDateInvalid: Enter a valid expiration date. Check that the month, day, and year are correct.
licensure.expirationBeforeIssue: Expiration date must be after the issue date.
licensure.expirationExpired: This license appears to have expired. Verify the expiration date, or contact the VAMC HR office about your license status.
licensure.licenseStatusRequired: Select the current status of this license.
licensure.restrictionExplanationRequired: Explain the restriction or non-active status of this license.
licensure.restrictionExplanationMinLength: Your explanation must be at least 10 characters.
licensure.restrictionExplanationMaxLength: Your explanation must be 2,000 characters or fewer.
licensure.atLeastOneLicenseRequired: Add at least one professional license before continuing.

boardCertification.certifyingBoardRequired: Select the certifying board or organization.
boardCertification.certifyingBoardOtherRequired: Enter the name of the certifying organization.
boardCertification.specialtyRequired: Enter the specialty or subspecialty certified.
boardCertification.specialtyMaxLength: Specialty must be 200 characters or fewer.
boardCertification.certificationNumberMaxLength: Certification number must be 50 characters or fewer.
boardCertification.initialDateRequired: Enter the date of initial certification.
boardCertification.initialDateInvalid: Enter a valid initial certification date.
boardCertification.initialDateFuture: Initial certification date can't be in the future.
boardCertification.expirationDateInvalid: Enter a valid expiration or recertification date.
boardCertification.certificationStatusRequired: Select the current status of this certification.
boardCertification.lapseExplanationRequired: Explain why this certification lapsed or was revoked.
boardCertification.lapseExplanationMaxLength: Your explanation must be 1,000 characters or fewer.

deaRegistration.applicableRequired: Tell us whether you hold or need a DEA registration.
deaRegistration.deaNumberPattern: Enter a valid DEA number. DEA numbers are 2 letters followed by 7 digits. Example: AB1234567.
deaRegistration.schedulesRequired: Select at least one controlled substance schedule authorized under your DEA registration.
deaRegistration.issueDateRequired: Enter your DEA registration issue date.
deaRegistration.issueDateInvalid: Enter a valid DEA issue date.
deaRegistration.expirationDateRequired: Enter your DEA registration expiration date.
deaRegistration.expirationDateInvalid: Enter a valid DEA expiration date.
deaRegistration.deaExpiringSoon: Your DEA registration is expiring within 90 days. Renew your registration before you start VA clinical duties.
deaRegistration.deaExpired: Your DEA registration has expired. Contact the DEA to renew before starting VA clinical duties.
deaRegistration.stateRequired: Enter the state or states where your DEA registration is valid.

education.institutionNameRequired: Enter the name of your degree-granting institution.
education.institutionNameMaxLength: Institution name must be 200 characters or fewer.
education.fieldOfStudyRequired: Enter your field of study or major.
education.fieldOfStudyMaxLength: Field of study must be 200 characters or fewer.
education.graduationDateFuture: Graduation date can't be in the future.
education.institutionCityRequired: Enter the city where your institution is located.
education.institutionStateRequired: Select the state where your institution is located.

postgraduateTraining.trainingTypeRequired: Select the type of postgraduate training.
postgraduateTraining.programNameRequired: Enter the name of the training program.
postgraduateTraining.programNameMaxLength: Program name must be 200 characters or fewer.
postgraduateTraining.sponsoringInstitutionRequired: Enter the name of the sponsoring institution.
postgraduateTraining.sponsoringInstitutionMaxLength: Institution name must be 200 characters or fewer.
postgraduateTraining.specialtyRequired: Enter the specialty or focus area of this training.
postgraduateTraining.startDateInvalid: Enter a valid training start date.
postgraduateTraining.startDateFuture: Training start date can't be in the future.
postgraduateTraining.endDateInvalid: Enter a valid training end date.
postgraduateTraining.endDateBeforeStart: Training end date must be after the start date.
postgraduateTraining.completionStatusRequired: Tell us whether you completed this training program.
postgraduateTraining.nonCompletionExplanationRequired: Explain why you didn't complete this training program.
postgraduateTraining.nonCompletionExplanationMinLength: Your explanation must be at least 10 characters.
postgraduateTraining.nonCompletionExplanationMaxLength: Your explanation must be 1,000 characters or fewer.

employmentHistory.employerNameRequired: Enter the employer or facility name.
employmentHistory.employerNameMaxLength: Employer name must be 200 characters or fewer.
employmentHistory.positionTitleRequired: Enter your position or job title.
employmentHistory.positionTitleMaxLength: Position title must be 200 characters or fewer.
employmentHistory.startDateRequired: Enter your start date at this employer.
employmentHistory.startDateFuture: Employment start date can't be in the future.
employmentHistory.endDateBeforeStart: End date must be after the start date.
employmentHistory.reasonForLeavingMaxLength: Reason for leaving must be 500 characters or fewer.
employmentHistory.atLeastOneEntryRequired: Add at least one employment entry before continuing.
employmentHistory.incompleteHistoryWarning: Your employment history covers fewer than 10 years. Make sure all positions from the past 10 years are listed, or explain any gaps using the gap explanation fields.

employmentGap.explanationRequired: Explain what you were doing during this employment gap.
employmentGap.explanationMinLength: Your explanation must be at least 10 characters.
employmentGap.explanationMaxLength: Your explanation must be 1,000 characters or fewer.

references.titleRequired: Enter the reference's professional title and credentials.
references.institutionRequired: Enter the institution or organization where this reference works.
references.phonePattern: Enter a valid 10-digit U.S. phone number for this reference.
references.emailPattern: Enter a valid email address for this reference.
references.relationshipRequired: Select this reference's relationship to you.
references.yearsKnownRequired: Enter the number of years you have known this reference.
references.yearsKnownMin: Years known must be 0 or more.
references.yearsKnownMax: Years known must be 60 or fewer.
references.minimumReferencesRequired: Add at least 3 professional references before continuing.
references.personalReferenceWarning: Professional references should be colleagues, supervisors, or clinical peers — not family members or personal friends.

adverseHistory.licensureActionRequired: Tell us whether any licensing board has ever taken adverse action against your license.
adverseHistory.licensureActionTypeRequired: Select the type of adverse action.
adverseHistory.licensureActionStateRequired: Select the state or jurisdiction of the licensing board.
adverseHistory.licensureActionDateRequired: Enter the date of this adverse action.
adverseHistory.licensureActionDateInvalid: Enter a valid date for this adverse action.
adverseHistory.licensureActionDateFuture: Adverse action date can't be in the future.
adverseHistory.licensureActionExplanationRequired: Explain the circumstances of this adverse action.
adverseHistory.licensureActionExplanationMinLength: Your explanation must be at least 10 characters.
adverseHistory.licensureActionExplanationMaxLength: Your explanation must be 3,000 characters or fewer.
adverseHistory.malpracticeRequired: Tell us whether you have ever had a malpractice claim filed against you.
adverseHistory.malpracticeIncidentDateRequired: Enter the date of the malpractice incident.
adverseHistory.malpracticeClaimDateRequired: Enter the date the claim was filed.
adverseHistory.malpracticeClaimDateInvalid: Enter a valid claim filing date.
adverseHistory.malpracticeClaimDateBeforeIncident: The claim filing date must be on or after the incident date.
adverseHistory.malpracticeOutcomeRequired: Select the outcome of this claim.
adverseHistory.malpracticeAmountRequired: Enter the settlement or judgment amount in U.S. dollars.
adverseHistory.malpracticeAmountMin: Enter an amount of $0 or more.
adverseHistory.malpracticeExplanationRequired: Briefly explain the nature of this claim.
adverseHistory.malpracticeExplanationMinLength: Your explanation must be at least 10 characters.
adverseHistory.malpracticeExplanationMaxLength: Your explanation must be 3,000 characters or fewer.
adverseHistory.clinicalPrivilegesRequired: Tell us whether your clinical privileges have ever been denied, suspended, or revoked.
adverseHistory.clinicalPrivilegesExplanationRequired: Explain the circumstances of this clinical privileges action.
adverseHistory.clinicalPrivilegesExplanationMinLength: Your explanation must be at least 10 characters.
adverseHistory.clinicalPrivilegesExplanationMaxLength: Your explanation must be 3,000 characters or fewer.
adverseHistory.clinicalPrivilegesDateRequired: Enter the date of this action.
adverseHistory.clinicalPrivilegesDateInvalid: Enter a valid date for this action.
adverseHistory.deaActionRequired: Tell us whether your DEA registration has ever been denied, suspended, or revoked.
adverseHistory.deaActionExplanationRequired: Explain the circumstances of this DEA registration action.
adverseHistory.deaActionExplanationMaxLength: Your explanation must be 3,000 characters or fewer.
adverseHistory.deaActionDateRequired: Enter the date of this DEA action.
adverseHistory.deaActionDateInvalid: Enter a valid date for this DEA action.
adverseHistory.criminalHistoryFelonyRequired: Tell us whether you have ever been convicted of a felony.
adverseHistory.criminalHistoryMisdemeanorRequired: Tell us whether you have ever been convicted of a misdemeanor.
adverseHistory.criminalExplanationRequired: Explain the circumstances of this conviction.
adverseHistory.criminalExplanationMinLength: Your explanation must be at least 10 characters.
adverseHistory.criminalExplanationMaxLength: Your explanation must be 3,000 characters or fewer.
adverseHistory.criminalConvictionDateRequired: Enter the date of this conviction.
adverseHistory.criminalJurisdictionRequired: Enter the jurisdiction or court where this conviction occurred.
adverseHistory.federalExclusionRequired: Tell us whether you are currently on any federal healthcare exclusion list.
adverseHistory.federalExclusionDisqualifying: Individuals currently listed on the HHS OIG exclusion list or the SAM.gov excluded parties list are not eligible for a VHA clinical position. This application can't be submitted. Contact the VA Medical Center HR office for guidance.

documentUpload.fileTooLarge: This file is too large. The maximum file size is 20 MB. Compress or reduce the file size and try again.
documentUpload.invalidFileType: This file type isn't accepted. Upload a PDF, JPG, or PNG file.
documentUpload.uploadFailed: We couldn't upload your file. Try again. If the problem continues, call us at 1-800-698-2411 (TTY: 711).
documentUpload.uploadInProgress: Your file is uploading. Wait until the upload is complete before continuing.
documentUpload.licenseUploadRequired: Upload a copy of each professional license listed in the Licensure section before you submit.
documentUpload.licenseUploadWarning: You haven't uploaded copies of your professional licenses. Your application may be delayed without them.
documentUpload.deaCertificateRequired: Upload a copy of your current DEA registration certificate.
documentUpload.documentDescriptionMaxLength: Document description must be 200 characters or fewer.

facilityInformation.facilityRequired: Select the VA Medical Center or facility where you are applying.
facilityInformation.positionTitleRequired: Enter the position or job title for this application.
facilityInformation.positionTitleMaxLength: Position title must be 200 characters or fewer.
facilityInformation.appointmentTypeRequired: Select the type of appointment you are seeking.
facilityInformation.priorFacilityRequired: Enter the name of the VA facility where you most recently held clinical privileges.
facilityInformation.priorFacilityMaxLength: Facility name must be 200 characters or fewer.

attestation.accuracyAttestationRequired: Check the box to certify that your application information is true and complete.
attestation.backgroundInvestigationAuthRequired: Check the box to authorize the background investigation.
attestation.releaseOfInfoAuthRequired: Check the box to authorize the release of your information.
attestation.npdbAcknowledgmentRequired: Check the box to acknowledge the NPDB query requirement.
attestation.signatureRequired: Type your full legal name to sign this application.
attestation.signatureDoesNotMatch: The name you entered doesn't match your application. Enter your name exactly as: {firstName} {middleName} {lastName}.
attestation.signatureMaxLength: Signature must be 150 characters or fewer.
attestation.signatureDateRequired: Enter the date of your signature.
attestation.signatureDateFuture: Signature date can't be in the future.
attestation.signatureDateTooOld: Signature date can't be more than 7 days in the past. Enter today's date or a recent date.

pageValidation.requiredFieldsIncomplete: Some required information is missing. Fix the errors below before you continue.
pageValidation.reviewPageIncomplete: Some required information is missing from your application. Review and complete the sections listed below before you submit.
pageValidation.federalExclusionBlocksSubmission: Your application can't be submitted because you indicated you are currently on a federal healthcare exclusion list. Contact the VA Medical Center HR office for guidance.
pageValidation.noLicenseUploaded: You haven't uploaded your professional license copies. Uploading license copies is required. Your application may be delayed without them.

saveInProgress.saveSuccess: Your application has been saved. You can return to it at any time by signing in to VA.gov.
saveInProgress.saveFailed: We couldn't save your application. Your recent changes may not be saved. Try again. If the problem continues, call us at 1-800-698-2411 (TTY: 711).
saveInProgress.saveFailedRetry: We're having trouble saving your application. We'll try again automatically. Don't close this page.
saveInProgress.sessionExpiringSoon: Your session will expire in 2 minutes. Select 'Continue session' to keep working, or your progress since the last save may be lost.
saveInProgress.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue your application. Your saved progress is still available.
saveInProgress.applicationExpired: Your saved application has expired after 60 days of inactivity. You'll need to start a new application.
saveInProgress.returnToSavedForm: You have a saved application from {savedDate}. Continue where you left off or start a new application.

submission.submitSuccess: Your application has been submitted successfully. Your reference number is {referenceNumber}. Save this number for your records.
submission.submitFailedGeneric: We couldn't submit your application. Try again in a few minutes. If the problem continues, call us at 1-800-698-2411 (TTY: 711).
submission.submitFailedTimeout: The submission timed out. Check your internet connection and try again. Your application has been saved.
submission.submitFailedServerError: Something went wrong on our end. Your application wasn't submitted. Try again. If the problem continues, call us at 1-800-698-2411 (TTY: 711).
submission.submitFailedDuplicate: It looks like this application may have already been submitted. Check your email for a confirmation, or call the VAMC HR office to verify.
submission.submitInProgress: Submitting your application. Don't close this page.
submission.submitRetryPrompt: Your application wasn't submitted. Your information has been saved. Select 'Try again' to resubmit.

authentication.notSignedIn: You must sign in to complete this application. Your progress will be saved so you can return where you left off.
authentication.signInRequired: Sign in with your Login.gov or ID.me account to start or continue your application.
authentication.insufficientLoa: Your account needs additional verification to access this form. Verify your identity with Login.gov or ID.me to continue.
authentication.signInError: We couldn't sign you in. Try again. If the problem continues, call us at 1-800-698-2411 (TTY: 711).

systemAlerts.formUnavailable: This form is temporarily unavailable. Try again later. If you need help right away, call us at 1-800-698-2411 (TTY: 711).
systemAlerts.maintenanceWindow: VA.gov is undergoing maintenance from {startTime} to {endTime}. The form will be available after maintenance is complete.
systemAlerts.pilotScopeNotice: The online version of VA Form 10-2850e is currently available at select VA Medical Centers only. Contact the HR office at the facility where you are applying to confirm digital submission is available.
